sentences.text: Brachyuranochampsa was an extinct genus of crocodilian.
Brachyuranochampsa is an extinct crocodilian genus closely related to the family Crocodylidae but not part of it.
The parent group of Brachyuranochampsa is Crocodyloidea.
This animal lived from the Campanian to the Bartonian stages, between 83.6 and 39.7 million years ago.
The only robust fossil record of Brachyuranochampsa is the species B. eversolei found in the Middle Eocene of Wyoming.
The species B. zangerli, found in the lower Bridger Formation at Grizzly Buttes, has been synonymized with the primitive crocodilian "Crocodylus" affinis.
